newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche, Gilead set 'flu drug tests.
newsitem.headline: Roche, Gilead set 'flu drug tests.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said F Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd and Gilead Sciences Inc had started human testing of GS 4104, an oral therapy for the potential treatment and prevention of viral influenza.

The study, being conducted in Britain, aims to test the safety, tolerability and absorption of the drug. "Upon successful completion of initial studies, Roche and Gilead plan to commence a worldwide clinical trial programme in patients infected with Influenza A and B strains," it said.
GS 4104 inhibits neuraminidase, an enzyme that lets newly formed viruses escape from infected cells and is necessary to spread influenza, it said. The drug has proved effective in animal studies.

An estimated 120 million people in North America, western Europe and Japan are infected with the influenza virus every year, it said, adding treatments now available have provided only modest benefit for patients.
